newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Liberty to invest 50 mln rand in Kagiso.
newsitem.headline: Liberty to invest 50 mln rand in Kagiso.

text.p: Life insurer Liberty Life Association of Africa Ltd said on Wednesday it would invest 50 million rand in Kagiso Trust Investment Company (KTI) to facilitate the ongoing funding and development of the group.
The move was in line with Liberty Life's commitment to invest in companies and organisations that support community interests, the companies said in a joint statement.

KTI was established in 1993 to augment the resources of its parent company Kagiso Trust which has invested over a billion rand in the past ten years in a wide range of programmes in the employment, education and infrastructure spheres.
KTI's other interests consist of investments in the food, motor and building sectors.

"By providing additional capital to KTI, Liberty Life will be facilitating the ongoing development of the company which has already made a significant impact in its current investment programme", the companies said.
Liberty Life managing director Alan Romanis would join the KTI board as a non-executive director.
KTI earlier this month announced that it had become joint controlling shareholder of printing group Perskorgroep Ltd.
